description: MainActivity.java defines an Android activity that displays a ViewPager with mixed content (images and text) and integrates a ShareActionProvider to share the current content. It manages content display, updates sharing intent on page change, and references external layout and resource files.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that displays a ViewPager with mixed content and manages sharing via ShareActionProvider.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and configures the ViewPager and its adapter.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the menu, retrieves the ShareActionProvider, and sets the initial share intent.

methods.name: setShareIntent
methods.description: Updates the ShareActionProvider with the share intent of the current item.
